subject: [PATCH v5 1/3] mm: swap: move LRU insertion out of the swap cache allocator

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch moves the insertion of a new folio into the LRU (Least Recently Used) list out of the swap cache allocator function. This is done to allow callers of this function to act on the folio before it becomes visible for reclaim, which was not possible with the previous implementation. The change also enables zswap writeback dropbehind by preventing the buffer folio from being added to the LRU prematurely. The patch does not introduce any functional changes and only modifies the timing of when the LRU insertion occurs.
